newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bonn sets auction for Series 121 Bobl bond. [CORRECTED 15:15 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Bonn sets auction for Series 121 Bobl bond. [CORRECTED 15:15 GMT]

text.p: The German government will cease tap issuance to non-bank investors of its Series 121 five-year Bobl bonds on Monday, February 24, at 1100 GMT and has set an auction at which it aims to top up the issue by 10 billion marks, the Bundesbank as issuing agent said on Monday.
The government will at the same time announce terms for a Series 122 tap issue which will go on sale to non-banks, replacing the Series 121, the Bundesbank said.
Bids by banks for the Series 121 auction are due by 1000 GMT on Tuesday, February 25 (corrects from December 25).

The government is aiming for a top-up volume of 10 billion marks for the Series 121. That volume comprises the auction issue volume plus a portion of the bond which will be retained by the Bundesbank for market-tending purposes. --Frankfurt Newsroom, +49 69 756525
